introHtml: Pocketed babies and toddlers items add functionality to giveaways, keeping essentials like pacifiers or small toys close at hand. Whether you choose bibs, blankets, or plush toys with storage, the pocket feature turns a simple promotional product into a practical keepsake. Ideal for hospitals, daycares, or family-focused brands, these items offer high visibility for your logo while serving new parents. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a soft, lasting impression.
